//go:build ignore

// wtmpgen NOW: writes the last test's wtmp records to stdout, oldest first.
package main

import (
	"encoding/binary"
	"net/netip"
	"os"
	"strconv"
)

func rec(typ, pid int, line, id, user, host string, sec int64, addr string) []byte {
	b := make([]byte, 384)
	le := binary.LittleEndian
	le.PutUint16(b[0:], uint16(typ))
	le.PutUint32(b[4:], uint32(pid))
	copy(b[8:40], line)
	copy(b[40:44], id)
	copy(b[44:76], user)
	copy(b[76:332], host)
	le.PutUint32(b[340:], uint32(sec))
	if addr != "" {
		a := netip.MustParseAddr(addr)
		if a.Is4() {
			v := a.As4()
			copy(b[348:], v[:])
		} else {
			v := a.As16()
			copy(b[348:], v[:])
		}
	}
	return b
}

func main() {
	now, _ := strconv.ParseInt(os.Args[1], 10, 64)
	t0 := now - 3*86400 - 7200
	var out []byte
	w := func(b []byte) { out = append(out, b...) }
	// boot A: crashes (no shutdown record)
	w(rec(2, 0, "~", "~~", "reboot", "5.14.0-a", t0, ""))
	w(rec(7, 101, "pts/0", "ts/0", "alice", "10.0.0.5", t0+60, "10.0.0.5"))
	w(rec(7, 102, "tty1", "tty1", "bob", "", t0+120, ""))
	w(rec(8, 101, "pts/0", "ts/0", "", "", t0+3600+59, ""))
	// boot B: shut down cleanly
	w(rec(2, 0, "~", "~~", "reboot", "5.14.0-b", t0+86400, ""))
	w(rec(7, 201, "pts/1", "ts/1", "carol", "ws.example.com:0", t0+86400+300, "192.168.1.20"))
	w(rec(7, 202, "pts/4", "ts/4", "frank", "h4", t0+86400+400, ""))
	w(rec(8, 202, "pts/4", "ts/4", "", "", t0+86400+500, ""))
	w(rec(7, 203, "pts/4", "ts/4", "gina", "h5", t0+86400+600, ""))
	w(rec(8, 203, "pts/4", "ts/4", "", "", t0+86400+3*3600+700, ""))
	w(rec(1, 0, "~", "~~", "shutdown", "5.14.0-b", t0+2*86400, ""))
	// boot C: running
	w(rec(2, 0, "~", "~~", "reboot", "5.14.0-c", t0+2*86400+600, ""))
	w(rec(7, 1, "pts/2", "ts/2", "ghost", "fe80::1%eth0", now-3600, "fe80::1"))
	w(rec(7, 99999, "pts/3", "ts/3", "eve", "10.9.9.9", now-1800, "10.9.9.9"))
	w(rec(7, 301, "pts/5", "ts/5", "longusername1", "a-very-long-host-name.example.com", now-1700, ""))
	w(rec(8, 301, "pts/5", "ts/5", "", "", now-1600, ""))
	os.Stdout.Write(out)
}
